contract.note: 本岛特色挡路件：占一格且有碰撞，锚点=格心落地点；挡人时半透明；与 prop-m 同尺寸，画本岛题材

prompts.default: Game environment raster asset. Rounded chunky hand-painted cartoon, soft dark purple-brown outlines, ONLY 2–3 clear flat shade levels, simple broad shapes, small brief highlights. Match chibi fantasy actors. NO photographic texture, noise, micro-detail, airbrush shading, black outlines, text, labels, frames or watermark. ONE isolated 铃架残骸, muted mist-green wet stone, sparse moss, subtle bell-shaped details. 2:1 isometric, upper-left light. True transparent background, compact silhouette and small elliptical contact shadow. No scenery or slab base. Must be readable at 64px wide, at most 80px tall.
